all_lore_bonus_note: Award all_lore_bonus if the player read every lore card available on their chosen path. Use lore_bonus_aidlc_required for the Express/AIDLC route and lore_bonus_manual_required for the Manual route. Path-exclusive cards not on the taken route (e.g. 302/902 for AIDLC, 603/604 for Manual) are not required.
